items.q: How they look out for people
items.body: The first time I met hark, I was eating alone at the gurudwara (sikh temple). I was feeling a bit out of place. Hark sat down next to me and said he didn’t want me to eat alone and feel left out. He’s an amazing friend.

items.q: Something you can count on them for
items.body: You can count on Hark to be the friendliest most energised person in the room. Always open and smiling and interested in other people and their interests

items.q: Something you can count on them for
items.body: Hark always brings the most amazing, warm, upbeat light, energy into every situation. You can always count on him to be positive, supportive and kind.
I work with Hark and he is incredibly kind. My biggest fear is that the woman he meets would not be worthy of him. He is the one person that you can always count on to show up.

feed.a:
- Being able to talk about anything,
- Sit in silence for hours,
- laugh at something deeply stupid,
- long hugs for no reason,
- and still kiss in the kitchen like we just met.
